label: preparing
what: A coordinated, discreet gathering at the town hall for day 1 at 18:00, with 200 fresh loaves arranged among baker, innkeeper and freight and builder accepting the 101-emerald committee debt. The lighting review provides the confirmed appointment. It may celebrate my forty years as mayor, but that purpose remains speculation. Secretary knowingly assists with arrangements and payment clarification; no evidence establishes neighbour or watchman as organizers.
